stories.new_fact: The United States will ban listed Canadian imports effective September 29 and exclude Canadian products from some long-term government contracts.
stories.new_takeaway: The trade story moved from invoice repricing to supply availability, procurement eligibility and substitution planning.
stories.why_now: AP published the new U.S. ban and contract-exclusion actions today after Canada's retaliatory tariffs took effect yesterday.
stories.previous_coverage: September 8 covered Canadian tariffs taking effect; this adds a U.S. import-ban effective date and procurement lever.
stories.uncertainty: Carve-outs, product classifications, customs guidance and any resumed negotiations remain unclear.
stories.watch: Watch for customs guidance or exemptions before September 29.

stories.new_fact: Brent crude surpassed $100 for the first time since July after new Middle East attacks, with gasoline and diesel prices rising.
stories.new_takeaway: Energy is now the bridge from national security to household budgets, logistics costs and the Fed's September meeting.
stories.why_now: AP reported the Wednesday price threshold and attack sequence before this morning's script cutoff.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent episodes covered oil risk and Iran escalation; today's $100 Brent threshold and fuel prices are the new development.
stories.uncertainty: Oil may fade if shipping recovers or talks reopen; infrastructure damage could push prices higher.
stories.watch: Watch Brent, diesel, Treasury yields and Thursday-Friday inflation data.

stories.new_fact: Columbus City Schools voted Tuesday to join national litigation against social-media companies.
stories.new_takeaway: The district is trying to shift some student-support costs and leverage onto platform companies rather than only managing the effects internally.
stories.why_now: The board vote occurred Tuesday and Axios Columbus reported it Wednesday morning.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent local coverage focused on Flock, COTA, schools finance and data centers, not this lawsuit.
stories.uncertainty: The amount or timing of any recovery for Columbus is unknown and companies dispute causation.
stories.watch: Watch the Arizona and South Carolina school trials scheduled for February 2027.

stories.new_fact: MBA survey data for the week ending September 4 showed total applications down 2.7%, refinance applications down 6%, and purchase applications nearly flat on a seasonally adjusted basis.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational response is refinance triage and purchase-file prioritization by documented benefit or contract deadline, not broad rate marketing.
stories.why_now: The September 4 MBA survey data was published September 9.
stories.previous_coverage: Previous episodes repeatedly covered high-six rates and borrower segmentation; this segment changes the focus to refi lead triage and capacity allocation.
stories.uncertainty: The MBA primary page was not available in search results; numbers are carried by a secondary publication quoting MBA survey data.
stories.watch: Watch Thursday's Freddie Mac survey and 10-year Treasury reaction to inflation data.

stories.new_fact: JPMorganChase's annual report says LLM Suite launched in 2024 to more than 200,000 colleagues and describes AI-adjacent trusted-client advisory and safe-commerce product direction.
stories.new_takeaway: The bank-AI evidence distinction is adoption scale versus task-level productivity or customer-outcome metrics.
stories.why_now: The ledger required a weekly recheck and row expansion; this public annual-report evidence fills a previously open JPMorganChase row.
stories.previous_coverage: Previous bank-AI segments used Nubank, VMware and Better; JPMorganChase was listed as an open row to research.
stories.uncertainty: No controlled AI productivity, quality or revenue metric is disclosed.
stories.watch: Watch JPMorganChase earnings, investor-day or product disclosures for task-level LLM Suite metrics.
stories.date_exception: Specialist beat used older public implementation evidence as a ledger update; it is explicitly labeled background and does not count toward the four fresh stories.
stories.ledger_row_changed: JPMorganChase - lane 7 internal productivity and trusted-client advisory - new production row added with company-claim evidence and no disclosed task-level metric.

stories.new_fact: OpenAI released a proposed Navier-Stokes proof, a Lean formalization, and process details about a roughly 10,000-agent effort.
stories.new_takeaway: Frontier capability is moving toward large coordinated research programs, but acceptance depends on formal verification and outside expert review.
stories.why_now: OpenAI published the primary source September 8 and it had not appeared in prior episodes.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier coverage focused on Astra, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber and agent-safety incidents, not this mathematical proof claim.
stories.uncertainty: The mathematical community has not yet independently accepted the proof as resolving the Clay problem.
stories.watch: Watch expert review of the Lean formalization and any response from Clay or independent mathematicians.
stories.frontier_bar: New capability with measured process evidence; not independent acceptance.

stories.new_takeaway: Markets and local planning both hinge on energy and the midweek storm window.
stories.why_now: Markets and weather were checked before the script cutoff.
stories.uncertainty: Live market and weather pages update continuously.
